title: FSS E-Jets E190/E195, Presidential A320s & a UFO?! | MSFS Marketplace
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down a widely contrasting trio of brand-new arrivals on the MSFS 2020 Marketplace—spanning authentic regional airline operations to straight-up sci-fi novelties.

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect these new Marketplace releases and detail what each developer brings to the platform:

Flight Sim Studio E-Jet Series E190 & E195: The highly anticipated regional airliners have arrived. We look at the incredibly detailed 3D model, complete with long and short winglets, custom sound pack, and authentic flight dynamics configured by a real-world airline pilot. We inspect the in-depth system simulation, featuring custom hydraulics, ice protection, steep approach mode, HUD, a fully functional load 27 MCDU, and a SimBrief-integrated EFB.

Dream Scenery A320neo Presidential Liveries: Transport the world's leaders with this pack of 5 highly detailed government fleet liveries for the A320neo. Includes distinctive national colors for Argentina, the United Kingdom, Japan, Spain, and Egypt.

Captain Sim UFO: Taking virtual aviation to the next galaxy! It’s a classic flying saucer featuring a high-res exterior, custom lighting, custom instruments, six liveries, and out-of-this-world altitude capabilities. Is it realistic? That's up for debate, but it certainly breaks the mold!

Whether you are flying commuter schedules in the E-Jets or abducting ground vehicles in the UFO, we evaluate this ramp inspection to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! Are you picking up the E-Jets or taking the UFO into the skies?
